meta.title: PLANNED · Browser-native RAG
meta.subtitle: Approved design · NOT IMPLEMENTED. No Python API in this path.

cards.title: Design, not a runtime receipt
items: Approved local README design, October 7. No browser model, quality score or deployment is asserted by this diagram.
The Python consumer API remains an independent deliverable. It must not answer requests behind this browser-native claim.
Document bytes and questions are not uploaded. External runtime/model downloads still require a cold/warm network audit.

cards.title: One request, inspectable evidence
items: Show the answer or refusal first; expand actual chunk IDs, page references, scores, context budget and generator identity afterward.
Generation is real computation, not a template. Citation syntax is necessary but does not prove the financial fact.
A financial claim still needs the original PDF period, metric, column, amount and unit; failed evidence/citation checks withhold it.

cards.title: Lifecycle and refusal boundaries
items: Versioned messages carry request ID, stage, progress and typed outcome. Cancelled or stale operations cannot overwrite a new source or question.
Scanned/empty text, ambiguous table relationships, missing WebGPU, device loss, memory limits and initialization failures get explicit outcomes; no silent cloud fallback.
Model caching is not document persistence or guaranteed capacity. Clear only owned namespaces; document/index persistence requires explicit opt-in.
